company.name: Hazel
company.description: Hazel builds modern AI systems that transform how governments buy and build. From state and local agencies to the federal level, Hazel helps public institutions modernize procurement by making it faster, more transparent, and more effective. Our AI-powered tools streamline decision-making, uncover better vendor matches, and help agencies deliver millions in measurable public impact.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based procurement platform for government agencies to create solicitations, discover vendors, manage procurement documents, and support response evaluation.
productsAndServices.name: Hazel AI Procurement Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI-assisted solicitation builder that generates RFP, RFQ, and IFB drafts using agency templates, policies, boilerplate, and past award language.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Solicitations

productsAndServices.description: A vendor search and information tool for finding suppliers, including MWBE and SBE-certified businesses, and supporting procurement market research.
productsAndServices.name: Vendor Discovery and Market Intelligence

productsAndServices.description: AI-supported tools for reviewing procurement responses and helping agencies evaluate submissions against solicitation requirements and compliance criteria.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Assisted Evaluations
